thread:
Lee: Need a quick internal RN and ops pin for the v2.4.2 push tomorrow. Can we agree window and rollback lanes?
Carmen: Drop bullets and I'll trim for the internal blast.
Lee: Bullets: 
```
- Fix: KV cache ordering bug causing rare stale reads
- Perf: adaptive batching improvements reduce p99 by ~15% in short requests
- Ops: embeddings model pinned to rwd-embed-3 in EU; fallback to rwd-embed-2
- Infra: safer canary policy with auto-fallback to v2.4.0
```
Ibrahim: I can take rollback exec. My rollback triggers: sustained error increase >0.8% over 3m, p99 latency >850ms for 5m, or user-facing 5xx spike >2% in any 5m window.
Lee: Good. Who will claim ops pin? Need someone to post pinned RN after smoke pass.
Carmen: I can pin and run the announcement. I will include the escalation matrix and who to ping.
Lee: Plan: staging smoke at 09:45 PT, deploy 10:15 PT. Canary 10% 10m -> ramp 50% 10m -> full. Fallback to v2.4.0.
ReleaseBot: /schedule deploy service:v2.4.2 env:prod start:2026-04-02T10:15:00-07:00 rollout:canary(10%:10m)->ramp(50%:10m)->full fallback:service:v2.4.0
ReleaseBot: Scheduled by Lee. Details: https://deploy.example.org/s/13579
Ibrahim: I'll be standby until 11:30 PT. Keep rollback doc handy: https://wiki.example.org/rollback/v2.4.2
Carmen: Draft internal announce: 
```
Internal RN - service v2.4.2 (deploy 10:15 PT)
- Short bullets: fix/perf/ops/infra
- Rollout: canary 10% 10m -> ramp 50% 10m -> full
- Rollback triggers: Ibrahim owns rollback
- Staging smoke 09:45 PT required; pinned RN posted after smoke pass
- Contacts: Ibrahim (rollback), Carmen (ops pin), Lee (release owner)
```
Lee: Timed. Carmen please pin after smoke pass and I'll send the internal blast.
Carmen: Running smoke now. Will report back in this thread.
Carmen: Smoke PASS at 09:45 PT. CI logs: https://ci.example.org/builds/20202/logs. No regressions seen. Pinning RN and tagging @Oncall.
Oncall: Acknowledged. We'll monitor errors, latency, and customer 5xx rate during ramp.
Lee: Thanks. We'll watch metrics for the first 20m after full rollout. Ibrahim, ready your rollback runbook if thresholds hit.
Ibrahim: Ready. Have the rollback playbook open and the deploy link bookmarked.
